blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios. Recent single-temporal approaches address this limitation by learning structural evidence, such as building regions, from a labeled source dataset and transferring it to unseen target imagery using only the current image. However, adaptation to the source dataset can over-specialize pretrained features and reduce their cross-dataset generalization, a risk that this paper argues is higher when the feature adaptation is parameterized independently of the states used for prediction. To address this issue, the current study introduces SALT, a State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer framework. SALT keeps a DINOv3 backbone frozen and learns negative and positive structural states that both score each patch and, through State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA), span the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected. Directional State Alignment supervises these corrections to raise the evidence of positive patches and lower that of negative ones, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. Experiments on LEVIR-CD and the WHU aerial building dataset show that, at the pixel level and in both transfer directions, SALT outperforms four baselines reproduced under a common source-only protocol, improving over the strongest reproduced baselines by 9.45 and 5.79 points in pixel-level AP and by 27.69 and 14.25 points in IoU (LEVIR-CD to WHU and WHU to LEVIR-CD, respectively), with only 0.068M trainable parameters and 40.2 ms per image. In order to facilitate reproducibility and further research, the source code of SALT is available at https://github.com/gthpapadopoulos/SALT
blocks.zh: 遥感的变化探测通常依靠空间对齐的双时段图像,而这种图像在实际情况下可能无法提供或不可靠。 最近的单一时段方法通过学习结构证据,例如建筑区域,从标注的源数据集到仅使用当前图像的不见目标图像,来解决这一局限性。 然而,对源数据集的适应可以过度专门化预先训练的特征,并减少其跨数据集的概括性,本文认为,当特征适应独立于用于预测的状态参数化时,这种风险更高. 为了解决这一问题,本研究报告引入了SALT,即国家结盟低辐射转移框架。 SALT保持一个DINOv3主干线冷冻,并学习负和正结构态,每个补丁都得分,并通过州-州低Rank适应(SALA)跨越校正补丁特征的级别-2子空间. 定向状态校正监督这些校正,以提出正补丁的证据并降低负补丁的证据,而几何保存则限制预先训练的补丁特征之间的对偶关系变化. 对LEVIR-CD和WHU空中建筑数据集的实验表明,在像素水平和两个转动方向上,SALT都超过了根据共同的唯源协议复制的4个基线,比最强的再生基线在像素水平AP上提高了9.45和5.79分,在IoU上提高了27.69和14.25分(分别是LEVIR-CD到WHU和WHU到LEVIR-CD),只有0.068M可列车参数和每幅图像40.2 ms. 为了便于复制和进一步研究,SALT的源代码见https://github.com/gthpadopoulos/SALT。

blocks.en: Change detection in remote sensing typically relies on two spatially aligned images of the same area acquired at different times [ 23 , 3 ] . In practical applications, however, a suitable pre-event image may be unavailable, outdated, or difficult to align with the current observation. Recent approaches, such as FIFA-RS [ 16 ] and BSSRS [ 15 ] , address this limitation by learning structural information from a labeled source dataset and transferring it to unseen target imagery using only the current image. Unlike conventional bi-temporal change detection, this setting does not directly determine whether a structure has changed over time. Instead, the objective is to localize structural evidence defined by the source annotations, such as changed buildings in LEVIR-CD [ 3 ] or building footprints in WHU [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 遥感中的变化探测通常依赖于在不同时间获得的同一区域的两个空间对齐的图像[23,3]. 然而,在实际应用中,适当的事前图像可能无法提供、过时或难以与当前观察保持一致。 国际足联-RS [16]和BSSRS [15]等近期方法,通过从被标记的源数据集中学习结构信息并仅使用当前图像将其转移到看不见的目标图像来应对这一限制. 与常规双时态变化检测不同,此设置并不直接决定一个结构是否随时间变化. 相反,目标是将来源说明所定义的结构证据本地化,例如LEVIR-CD[3]或WHU[11]所建的脚印所改变的建筑物.

blocks.en: The main challenge is to learn source-specific structural information while preserving the generalization ability of pretrained visual representations. Features extracted from vision foundation models provide rich visual information, but may not directly distinguish the positive structures defined by the source task from the background. Adapting these features using source annotations can improve this distinction, but excessive adaptation may also distort useful pretrained representations and reduce their transferability to unseen datasets. This trade-off becomes particularly important when the source and target datasets differ in appearance, acquisition conditions, or annotation semantics.
blocks.zh: 主要的挑战在于学习针对源的结构信息,同时保留被预先训练的视觉表现的通俗化能力. 从视觉基础模型中提取的地物提供了丰富的视觉信息,但可能不会直接区分由源任务定义的正结构与背景. 使用源说明来调整这些特征可以改善这种区分,但过度调整也可能扭曲有用的事先训练过的表示,并降低其向看不见数据集的可转移性. 当来源和目标数据集在外观,获取条件或注释语义上有所不同时,这种权衡变得尤为重要.

blocks.en: Existing approaches address this challenge through different adaptation strategies. FIFA-RS [ 16 ] adapts frozen CLIP [ 24 ] representations for single-temporal structural anomaly reasoning, while BSSRS [ 15 ] combines CLIP and DINOv3 [ 26 ] features through constrained residual blending. Related visual anomaly detection methods also learn task-specific feature transformations. VisualAD [ 8 ] combines learned visual states with MLP-based feature recalibration, MoECLIP [ 21 ] employs specialized low-rank experts, and AVA-DINO [ 1 ] uses separate adaptation branches. Although these methods offer different ways to adapt pretrained representations, the adaptation directions are generally learned independently of the states or representations used for prediction.
blocks.zh: 现有方针通过不同的适应战略来应对这一挑战。 FIFA-RS [16] 将被冻结的 CLIP [24] 表示用于单时态结构异常推理,而 BSSRS [15] 则通过受限的剩余混合将 CLIP 和 DINOv3 [26] 特性结合. 相關的视觉异常检测方法也学习了任务特有特征的转变. VisualAD [8] 将所学的视觉状态与基于MLP的特性再校正相结合,MOECLIP [21] 雇用专业的低级专家,而AVA-DINO [1] 使用单独的适应分支. 虽然这些方法提供了不同的方式来调整预先训练过的表述,但适应方向一般独立于用于预测的状态或表述来学习.

blocks.en: This separation motivates a more direct connection between feature adaptation and structural prediction. Instead of learning arbitrary correction directions, feature adaptation can be constrained by the same structural states used to distinguish positive and negative regions. Such a constraint limits how pretrained features can change while allowing task-specific adjustments. The central idea is therefore to determine not only how much each feature should be adapted, but also which directions are relevant to the structural prediction task.
blocks.zh: 这种分离激发了特征适应和结构预测之间更直接的联系. 特征适应可不学习任意的校正方向,而受用来区分正和负区域的结构状态的限制。 这种限制限制了预先训练的特性如何改变,同时允许根据具体任务进行调整。 因此,中心思想是不仅要确定每个特征应调整多少,还要确定哪些方向与结构预测任务相关.

blocks.en: To this end, this paper introduces SALT (State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer), a framework that couples feature adaptation with structural prediction. SALT uses a frozen DINOv3 backbone and learns two structural states representing negative and positive evidence. These states serve two purposes: they are used to score each patch and to define the subspace in which its feature representation can be corrected. State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA), is introduced, to restrict feature corrections to this rank-2 subspace, while a lightweight predictor determines the correction coefficients for each patch. Directional State Alignment (DSA) guides these corrections to increase positive and decrease negative structural evidence, whereas Geometry Preservation limits changes to pairwise relationships among pretrained patch features. The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为此,本文介绍了SALT(国家-相通低辐射转移),这是夫妇结合结构预测进行适应的框架。 SALT使用被冷冻的DINOv3主干线并学习两个结构状态代表了负和正的证据. 这些状态有两个目的:它们用于给每个补丁打分并定义其特征表现可以被纠正的子空间. 采用了州-州-低Rank适应(SALA),将特征校正限制在这个级别-2子空间,而轻量级预测器则确定每个补丁的校正系数. 定向态对接(DSA)指导这些校正增加正向并减少负向结构证据,而几何保存则限制在预先训练的补丁特征之间改变成对关系. 本文件的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA) couples structural prediction and feature adaptation. The same learned positive and negative states used for prediction define the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected, limiting adaptation to state-derived directions. • Directional State Alignment (DSA) guides feature corrections toward increasing positive and decreasing negative structural evidence, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. • Cross-dataset experiments on LEVIR-CD and WHU demonstrate superior pixel-level localization over four reproduced baselines in both transfer directions under a common source-only protocol. SALT achieves the highest pixel-level AP with 69 × 69\times – 465 × 465\times fewer trainable parameters (Fig. 1 ), while ablation studies support the benefits of state-aligned adaptation.
blocks.zh: · 州-州-低辐射适应(SALA)夫妇结构预测和特征适应。 用于预测的同样有学问的正负状态定义了补丁特征被纠正的平分-2子空间,将适应限制在从状态得到的方向. · 定向国与国对接(DSA)指南的特点是纠正正向和正向的负面结构证据,而几何保护则限制在预先训练的补丁特征之间的对接关系。 • LEVIR-CD和WHU的跨数据集实验显示,在通用的仅源协议下,在两个转动方向的4个再生基线上,具有更好的像素级本地化。 SALT实现最高像素级AP,以69×69\times – 465×465\times减少可受训练参数(图1),而衰减研究则支持了状态相适应适应的效益.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Remote sensing change detection with reduced temporal supervision. Remote sensing change detection aims to identify regions that have changed between observations of the same area acquired at different times [ 23 , 4 ] . Conventional approaches therefore typically rely on aligned bi-temporal imagery. In this context, several works have investigated how to reduce the need for paired supervision during training. ChangeStar [ 35 ] learns from unpaired images with semantic annotations, while Self-Pair [ 25 ] creates training pairs from a single source image. Changen [ 36 ] and Changen2 [ 34 ] instead generate synthetic temporal changes and their corresponding labels. AnyChange [ 37 ] removes task-specific training through bitemporal latent matching in SAM, while SCL [ 6 ] combines single-temporal training data with vision-language prompt learning to generalize across change detection datasets without target-domain training. Foundation models have also been incorporated into conventional change detection, including ChangeCLIP [ 5 ] and BAN [ 14 ] . Nevertheless, these methods still require observations from two different times to produce the final change map.
blocks.zh: 遥感变化探测,减少时间监督. 遥感变化探测旨在查明在不同时间获得的同一区域观测之间发生变化的区域。 因此,常规办法通常依赖对齐的双时相图。 在这方面,一些工作研究了如何减少培训期间对配对监督的需要。 ChangeStar [35] 以语义注解从未发作的图像中学习,而自平 [25] 从单一源图像中创建了训练对. changen [36] and changenn2 [34] 转而产生合成时间变化及其相应的标签. AnyChange [37] 通过在 SAM 中进行咬入式潜在匹配,取消了任务特定培训,而SCL [6] 将单时段培训数据与视觉语言即时学习相结合,在没有目标域培训的情况下,将各种变化检测数据集进行概括. 基础模型也被纳入常规变化检测中,包括CLIP [5]和BAN [14]. 尽管如此,这些方法仍需要两个不同时间的观察才能产生出最终变化图.

blocks.en: Single-image remote sensing anomaly and structural localization. A separate line of research removes this temporal requirement and detects anomalous or structurally distinctive regions directly from a single remote sensing image. Li et al . [ 13 ] learn a transferable deviation metric that detects anomalies across different remote sensing modalities in a zero-shot manner, while Xu et al . [ 32 ] combine large vision models with lightweight priors for on-orbit Earth surface anomaly detection. RSAD-CLIP [ 33 ] further investigates vision-language representations for zero-shot Earth surface anomaly detection. More closely related to the considered setting, FIFA-RS [ 16 ] formulates change detection as single-temporal structural anomaly reasoning, using a frozen CLIP backbone, high-pass structural enhancement, and learnable multi-scale fusion. BSSRS [ 15 ] further addresses cross-dataset generalization by combining frozen CLIP and DINOv3 features, through constrained residual blending, to reduce structural over-specialization. FIFA-RS and BSSRS are the works closest to the considered protocol, in which only the current image is available and knowledge learned from a source dataset is directly transferred to an unseen target one. Both report F1 and IoU at the threshold that maximizes F1 on the target data, whereas the present study selects the decision threshold on the source validation split.
blocks.zh: 单相图遥感异常与结构定位. 单独一行的研究取消了这一时间要求,直接从单一遥感图像中检测出异常或结构有区别的区域。 Li等 [13] 学习可转移偏移度量度,以零发方式探测出不同遥感模式的异常,而徐等 [32] 结合了大型视觉模型和轻量级前兆,用于在轨地表异常探测. RSAD-CLIP [33]进一步调查了零射地表异常探测的视觉语言表现. 更紧密地与被考虑的设置相关,FIFA-RS [16] 将变化检测制定为单时态结构异常推理,使用被冻结的CLIP主干,高通结构增强,以及可学习的多尺度聚变. BSSRS [15] 进一步通过将被冻结的CLIP和DINOv3特征结合,通过受限的剩余混合,来解决跨数据集通化问题,以减少结构过度专业化. FIFA-RS和BSSRS是最接近被考虑的协议的作品,其中只有当前图像可用,从源数据集学到的知识被直接转移到一个看不见的目标. 报告F1和IoU都处于目标数据上F1最大化的阈值,而本研究则选择源验证分拆的决定阈值.

blocks.en: Zero-shot anomaly detection with vision-language models. Similar generalization challenges have been extensively investigated in zero-shot anomaly detection. Vision-language approaches typically represent normal and anomalous concepts through textual prompts and compare them with visual features. WinCLIP [ 10 ] combines handcrafted state words and prompt templates with multi-scale CLIP features, while AnomalyCLIP [ 38 ] learns object-agnostic normal and anomalous prompts. AdaCLIP [ 2 ] introduces static and image-dependent learnable prompts, whereas AA-CLIP [ 18 ] learns anomaly-aware textual anchors together with visual adaptation. Despite their strong generalization ability, these approaches still depend on textual representations and cross-modal alignment. This has motivated more recent methods to model anomaly evidence directly in the visual feature space.
blocks.zh: 用视觉语言模型进行零镜头异常探测. 在零发反常探测中,也广泛调查了类似的通化挑战. 视觉语言方法通常通过文字提示来代表正常和反常的概念,并将其与视觉特征作比较. WinCLIP [10] 结合了手动的状态词和有多尺度 CLIP 特性的即时模板,而AnomalyCLIP [38] 学习对象不可知的正常和异常的提示. AdaCLIP [2] 引入了静态和图像依赖可学习的提示,而AA-CLIP [18] 则学习了反常-认知的文本锚与视觉适应. 尽管这些办法具有很强的通俗化能力,但它们仍取决于文字表述和跨模式的一致。 这促使了近代方法在视觉特征空间直接模拟异常证据.

blocks.en: Visual anomaly modeling and feature adaptation. VisualAD [ 8 ] removes the language branch and learns visual states for normal and anomalous patterns together with an MLP-based feature recalibration. AnomalyVFM [ 7 ] adapts vision foundation models using low-rank feature adapters, while MoECLIP [ 21 ] performs patch-specific adaptation through dynamically routed LoRA [ 9 ] experts. AULoRA [ 19 ] also introduces low-rank adaptation into the CLIP visual encoder, while AVA-DINO [ 1 ] employs separate normal and anomalous adaptation branches with text-guided routing. Overall, these methods demonstrate the benefits of lightweight visual adaptation for anomaly discrimination. However, their adaptation mechanisms are learned separately from the visual states or representations used for the final prediction. Moreover, previous studies have shown that strong adaptation of pretrained representations can reduce their robustness under distribution shift [ 12 , 30 ] . Parameter-efficient alternatives keep the backbone frozen, such as Rein [ 29 ] , which refines frozen features with learnable tokens for domain-generalized semantic segmentation, and LoReFT [ 31 ] , which edits hidden representations within a learned low-rank subspace. SALT follows this representation-editing view, but instead of learning the subspace independently, it constructs the adaptation space directly from the learned structural states, so that the same states define both the prediction and the directions in which each feature can be corrected.
blocks.zh: 视觉异常的建模和特征适应. VisualAD [8] 移除了语言分支,并学习视觉状态,用于正常和反常的图案,同时进行基于MLP的特性再校正. AnomalyVFM [7] 使用低等特征适配器来适应视觉基础模型,而MOECLIP [21] 通过动态路由LORA [9] 专家来进行针对补丁的适应. AULORA [19] 还将低等级的适应引入了CLIP视觉编码器,而AVA-DINO [1] 则使用单独的普通和反常的适应分支,并配有文本引导的路由. 总的来说,这些方法显示了轻量级视觉适应异常歧视的好处。 然而,它们的适应机制与用于最终预测的可视状态或表述是分开学习的. 此外,以往的研究表明,严格调整预先训练过的表述可降低其在分配转变中的稳健性[12,30]. 参数高效的替代品使主干被冷冻,如:Rein [29]用可学习的符号来细化被冷冻的特征来进行域通语分化,而LoReFT [31]则在所学的低级子空间内编辑隐藏的表示. SALT遵循了这种表示编辑的观点,但是它不是独立地学习子空间,而是直接从所学的结构状态来构建适应空间,这样,同样的状态就既定义了预测,又定义了每个特征可以被纠正的方向.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: SALT learns task-specific structural information from a labeled source dataset, while limiting changes to the pretrained visual representation. Its overall architecture is illustrated in Fig. 2 . Given a single current image, a frozen DINOv3 backbone [ 26 ] extracts dense patch features, and two learnable structural states represent negative and positive structural evidence in this feature space (Section 3.3 ). State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA) corrects each patch feature within the rank-2 subspace spanned by the same states, with a lightweight coefficient predictor determining the magnitude of the correction along each direction (Section 3.4 ). Directional State Alignment (DSA) supervises these corrections to raise the evidence of positive patches and lower that of negative ones (Section 3.5 ), while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among the pretrained patch features (Section 3.6 ).
blocks.zh: SALT从被标记的源数据集中学习任务特定的结构信息,同时将修改限制在被预先训练的视觉表现. 其整体建筑图示于图2. . 鉴于一个单一的电流图像,被冻结的DINOv3主干线[26]取出稠密的补丁特征,两个可学习的结构状态代表了这个特征空间中的负正结构证据(第3.3节. blocks.en: 3.2 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.2 问题的提出

blocks.en: The task considered is single-temporal cross-dataset structural localization. Given a labeled source dataset containing images and binary segmentation masks, the objective is to learn structural representations that generalize to an unseen target domain. Image-level labels indicate the presence or absence of annotated positive regions, which are defined by the source task. At inference, only a single target image 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}^{t} is available. The model produces a dense structural response map 𝐒 t \mathbf{S}^{t} and an image-level score r t r^{t} , without access to a pre-event observation. All model parameters remain fixed, and binary predictions use a threshold selected on source validation data. No target-domain training, adaptation, or calibration is performed.

blocks.en: Datasets. Experiments are conducted on LEVIR-CD [ 3 ] and the aerial subset of the WHU Building Dataset [ 11 ] (hereafter WHU), following the single-temporal setting of FIFA-RS [ 16 ] and BSSRS [ 15 ] . LEVIR-CD contains 637 aligned bi-temporal image pairs of size 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 at 0.5 0.5 m/pixel with binary building-change annotations, split into 445 training, 64 validation, and 128 test pairs. Only the post-event image of each pair is used, with the change mask as the positive annotation. WHU contains 8,189 tiles of size 512 × 512 512\times 512 at 0.3 0.3 m/pixel with building-footprint masks, split into 4,736 training, 1,036 validation, and 2,416 test tiles. The two datasets therefore differ in positive semantics, since LEVIR-CD annotates changed buildings whereas WHU annotates all buildings in the current image, and also in ground sampling distance, since resizing to the network input yields approximately 1.0 1.0 and 0.3 0.3 m/pixel, respectively. The evaluation thus measures cross-dataset transfer of source-defined structural evidence, rather than conventional temporal change detection.

blocks.en: Baseline methods and reported performance. SALT is compared with four recent methods, namely FIFA-RS [ 16 ] , VisualAD [ 8 ] , AVA-DINO [ 1 ] , and MoECLIP [ 21 ] , all reproduced under the common source-only protocol of Section 4.1 with identical splits and seeds. Baselines use their official implementations and author-recommended hyperparameters, whereas SALT hyperparameters are selected on source validation. All methods use source-selected decision thresholds. VisualAD, originally built on CLIP and DINOv2 ViT-L/14 backbones, and AVA-DINO use the same frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone as SALT, whereas FIFA-RS and MoECLIP retain their original CLIP encoders, and methods requiring text use the remote sensing prompt set of FIFA-RS. The reproduced FIFA-RS reaches P-AUROC/P-AP of 94.28 / 68.76 94.28/68.76 and 88.14 / 28.67 88.14/28.67 in LEVIR-CD → \rightarrow WHU and WHU → \rightarrow LEVIR-CD, close to the 94.91 / 70.36 94.91/70.36 and 88.63 / 28.06 88.63/28.06 reported in [ 16 ] , while its lower F1 reflects the source-selected threshold. BSSRS [ 15 ] could not be reproduced, since its linked repository contained no code at the time of writing. For reference, it reports threshold-independent P-AUROC/P-AP of 95.38 / 71.00 95.38/71.00 and 90.41 / 31.74 90.41/31.74 for the two directions, obtained with its own training setup, and SALT exceeds both values in each direction ( 98.08 / 87.77 98.08/87.77 and 94.82 / 44.42 94.82/44.42 ), although the evaluation setups are not identical.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The current formulation represents structural evidence with a single pair of negative and positive states, which restricts SALA to a rank-2 adaptation space and may not capture heterogeneous positive appearances. Without a pre-event observation, the single-temporal setting cannot distinguish true temporal change from source-defined structural evidence, so that a model trained on building footprints also responds to buildings that predate the change, which likely contributes to the lower WHU → \rightarrow LEVIR-CD performance. The evaluation is further limited to one dataset pair, two transfer directions, and three seeds, with source and target differing jointly in annotation semantics and ground sampling distance. Future work could investigate multiple context-dependent states, adaptive-rank adaptation, and broader transfer across semantic, geographic, and sensor shifts, including targets whose annotations match the source semantics, such as the WHU building change detection dataset [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前的提法代表结构证据,单对正负态,将SALA限制在二级适应空间内,可能不会捕捉出相异正态外观. 没有事前观察,单时设置无法区分真实的时间变化和源定义的结构证据,因此一个在建筑脚印方面训练有素的模型也响应了变化前的建筑,这有可能促进下WHU →\正中LEVR-CD性能. 评价进一步限于一个数据集对、两个转接方向和三个种子,来源和目标在注释语义和地面采样距离上是不同的。 今后的工作可以调查多种依赖环境的状态,适应性的分级适应,以及更广泛的跨语义、地理和传感器相变的转移,包括说明与源语义相匹配的目标,如WHU建筑变化检测数据集[11].

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced SALT for single-temporal cross-dataset structural localization in remote sensing. SALT learns negative and positive structural states on a frozen DINOv3 backbone and uses the same states both to score each patch and to span the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected. Directional State Alignment supervises how these corrections change the structural evidence, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. On LEVIR-CD and WHU, SALT achieves the highest pixel-level performance among four reproduced baselines in both transfer directions with only 0.068 0.068 M trainable parameters, and ablations show that state-aligned adaptation outperforms both unrestricted and generic low-rank adaptation. These results support defining feature adaptation through the same states used for prediction.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了遥感中单时跨数据集结构定位的 SALT. SALT在被冻结的DINOv3主干上学习负正结构状态,并使用同状态来分出每个补丁,并跨出校正补丁特性的级别-2子空间. 方向态对接监督这些校正如何改变结构证据,而几何保存限制在预先训练补丁特征之间的对等关系变化. 在LEVIR-CD和WHU上,SALT在两个转动方向的4个再生基线中实现最高像素级性能,只有0.068 0.068 M可训练参数和平面显示,状态相适应的适应性优于不受限制的和通用的低等级适应. 这些结果有助于通过用于预测的相同状态确定特征适应。
